title: PROSPECT randomized trial in Blantyre, Malawi: HIV testing plus CAD4TB-read chest X-rays speeds TB treatment for adults with cough
summary: In the PROSPECT trial at a Blantyre clinic, TB patients offered HIV testing plus chest X-rays read by CAD4TB started treatment a median of 1 day after the visit, against 11 days under standard care.
account: Researchers from the Malawi-Liverpool-Wellcome Trust Clinical Research Programme, the Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine and the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine ran the PROSPECT trial at Bangwe Health Centre in Blantyre, Malawi. Between 15 November 2018 and 27 November 2019 they randomly assigned 1,462 adults with cough to standard care, to oral HIV testing with linkage to care, or to HIV testing plus a digital chest X-ray read by CAD4TB version 5 software. People in the X-ray arm whose score was 45 or higher gave sputum for an on-site Xpert test, and a radiologist also read the X-rays remotely. Within 56 days, 15 people in the X-ray arm had started TB treatment, against 5 in the standard-care arm; the authors report that this difference was not statistically significant. Median time to treatment was 1 day in the X-ray arm and 11 days under standard care (hazard ratio 2.86, 95% confidence interval 1.04 to 7.87), and 6 of the 15 patients in the X-ray arm started treatment on the day of the visit, against none of the 5 under standard care. TB was less common among participants than the investigators expected, and follow-up lasted 56 days. The authors estimate that the probability that the X-ray package was cost-effective at US$1,200 per quality-adjusted life year was 0%. The trial tests the X-ray and the software as one package. It does not compare the software with a human reader. Wellcome funded the study, and no author reports a tie to Delft Imaging.
purpose: CAD4TB was built to score chest X-rays for signs of pulmonary TB so that staff can decide who needs a confirmatory test. Faster diagnosis and treatment of TB was the purpose of its use in this trial.
